facts.text: Jon expresses gratitude towards Gina for her support during the process of establishing a dance studio.

evidence.quote: Glad I have you in my corner!

facts.text: Jon acknowledges the challenges of setting up the dance studio but remains determined to see it through.

evidence.quote: Looking for the right place and getting everything ready has been a mix of exciting and nerve-wracking, but I'm determined to make it work.
Success is almost here. We got this!

facts.text: Gina encourages Jon to continue pursuing their goals and believes in the positive outcome of their efforts.

evidence.quote: We've done so much, and there's nothing but good stuff coming. Let's keep going after our goals and making them happen.
